scenarios.prompt: Write TypeScript: resolve a user's UI theme. Read it from userSettings (Map<string, string>, keyed by user ID); the stored value may be missing or may be an unsupported string, and only 'light', 'dark' and 'system' are valid. When the user has no valid theme, write a debug log line with logger.debug(message), then fall back to the organization default from orgSettings (Map<string, string>, keyed by organization ID, same rules: may be missing or invalid). If that also yields nothing, use 'system'. Write it as one chain, without if statements or null checks.

output.result: a function (deps: { userSettings, orgSettings, logger }) => (userId: string, orgId: string) => the theme
